baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic nominal predicate joins the ص ل ي occurrence at word 3 directly to the ج ح م occurrence at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both mapped ص ل ي targets converge on contact with fire, while ج ح م intensifies that contact into a sustained blazing medium rather than a merely named destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 can evoke kindling, roasting, and straightening material over fire, with word 4 naming the extreme heat that performs the work.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can image the subjects as material actively worked upon by heat, adding process and alteration to the ordinary destination reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ج ح م noun at word 4 carries an eye branch alongside its fire branch, while word 3 keeps the subjects inside its field.
baseline_models.mechanism: The glowing or staring eye image overlays the blaze with exposure: the same medium that burns can be imagined as an unblinking field in which concealment fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking in full while imposing deficit becomes an account that returns to its makers: the fire-contact is the fully delivered counterweight to the short measure they exported.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the consequence as unavoidable contact rather than an abstract verdict.
Makes the returned consequence materially intense.
Supplies comparison between two quantities, exposing the transaction's unequal directions.
Supplies completion without deficit for what the offenders demand for themselves.
Supplies the just balance against which the asymmetry is judged.
Locates the wrong specifically in making another's measure or weight deficient.
Turns commercial asymmetry into an account that reaches reckoning and recompense.
Closes the mechanism with an outcome returning to the worker.

structural_cues: The branchless ط ف ف occurrence at 83:1 word 2 opens the deficient-measure frame and is used only as a structural cue.
The opposed participant roles in 83:2-3 and the closing question at 83:36 bracket the focus with extraction and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal measuring, demanded fullness, just balance, loss, reckoning, and returned recompense; I infer that the blaze is the account's exact counter-delivery. A live alternative is that these motifs explain desert rather than the mode of the fire itself.

changed_reading.before: They suffer a generally deserved fire.
changed_reading.after: They receive in full the returned counterpart of the deficits they imposed: the blaze functions as exact settlement of a rigged exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: Images of alignment, uprightness, and crossed limits activate the focus branch in which fire straightens material: the blaze makes chosen crookedness undergo forced alignment, without implying rehabilitation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies heating and turning a crooked object until it is made straight.
Provides the extreme heat that performs the coercive realignment.
Supplies alignment and comparison between two things as the violated material norm.
Adds uprightness, equilibrium, and straightness to the standing scene.
Supplies the decisive crossing of a boundary that makes forced realignment intelligible.

structural_cues: The branchless deficiency cue at 83:1 and the later standing scene move from a bent standard to compulsory uprightness.
The focus follows descriptions of repeated boundary-crossing rather than a single accidental error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparison, straightness, boundary-crossing, and a focus branch for fire-straightening; I supply the arrow from moral distortion to forced thermal alignment. The alternative is that straightening contributes only an image of severity, not a corrective function.

changed_reading.after: The blaze exposes and forcibly answers crooked measure by making distortion undergo straightening heat, with no claim that the subjects are restored.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enrollment, binding judgment, visible inscription, and confinement form an administrative chain; the focus is where the recorded placement becomes an embodied fiery condition.

activation_trace.role: Converts the prior documentary state into bodily encounter.
Supplies the material form taken by the executed sentence.

The mirrored record unit at 83:18-20 confirms that recorded class and experienced destination belong to one organizing structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligatory inscription, enrollment, marking, and confinement; I infer that fire-contact executes and embodies that registered determination. The record may alternatively remain evidentiary rather than causally operative.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a sentence announced independently of the record.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is the record made bodily: registered classification passes through confinement into lived sentence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rejected signs, false naming, and unreliable seeing culminate in direct fire-contact followed by a deictic declaration; the focus becomes compulsory verification of what speech had kept unreal.

activation_trace.role: Turns a disputed proposition into immediate sensory encounter.

structural_cues: The immediate 83:17 deictic statement points back to the focus encounter as the object formerly denied.
Repeated denial in 83:10-13 and 83:17 is later paired with seeing and mislabeling in 83:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, false speech, misjudging sight, direct heat-contact, and the immediate 'this' identification; I infer that the fire functions epistemically as forced verification. It may alternatively be punishment accompanied by a separate verbal rebuke.

changed_reading.before: The denied fire eventually punishes them.
changed_reading.after: The fire makes denial impossible by converting a rejected sign into direct experience: punishment also becomes compulsory knowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acquisition first forms an inescapable layer over the inner core, is named again as criminal earning, and finally returns to the actor; the focus externalizes that accumulated condition as an inhabitable blaze.

activation_trace.role: Makes the accumulated condition an environment that physically meets its makers.

Supplies an engulfing condition from which no exit is available.
Locates the first transformation at the person's inner core or essence.
Supplies repeated acquisition as the process producing the inner state.
Reactivates earning inside the later designation of the offenders.
Returns the acquired product to the one whose acts generated it.

structural_cues: The causal clause in 83:14 explicitly ties the inner layer to repeated acquisition.
The sequence moves from inner core in 83:14, to blocked relation in 83:15, to enclosing fiery encounter in 83:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, an inescapable inner condition, renewed earning language, and returned recompense; I infer an inside-to-outside materialization in which accumulated action becomes habitat. The live alternative keeps heart-layer and fire as distinct consequences.

changed_reading.before: An external fire is imposed on them after judgment.
changed_reading.after: What their repeated acts accumulated inwardly returns outwardly as the blazing environment they must inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate barrier before the focus and the later cluster of elevation, nearness, and freely supplied spring-water make the blaze the thermal and spatial form of exclusion from proximity.

Supplies prevention of access as the relational condition immediately preceding fire.
Supplies vertical elevation for the opposed destination.
Supplies admitted nearness and privileged presence as the relation denied to the focus subjects.
Adds being given drink and relieved of thirst to the opposed condition.
Supplies the flowing source from which the near ones drink.

structural_cues: The focus begins with a sequential connector immediately after the access-barrier of 83:15, making blaze follow relational exclusion.
The opposed unit in 83:18-28 repeatedly combines height, nearness, rest, radiance, and drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked access followed by fire, then an opposed field of height, nearness, and water; I infer that the blaze is not only pain but the experienced form of distance. The alternative treats exclusion and heat as adjacent but independent penalties.

changed_reading.before: They are first veiled and then separately burned.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is the positive environment of their exclusion: denied nearness becomes contact with its hot, waterless opposite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated looking, readable faces, mock-laughter, and reversed spectatorship activate the focus eye branch: those who used sight to classify others enter a blaze figured as an unblinking gaze that makes them readable instead.

The live alternative treats the eye branch as visual intensification with no social agency.

changed_reading.before: The fire is an object or place they experience.
changed_reading.after: The blaze also behaves like an unblinking exposure: those who judged by looking become the fully visible objects of a reversed gaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the local complement decisively selects fire-contact, yet the exact split root also preserves binding worship and the context supplies standing, lordship, barred access, and admitted nearness. Keep it only as a relational resonance, never as a lexical translation that they 'pray to' the blaze.

Supplies bodily standing, one of the postural echoes carried by the worship branch.
Supplies the sovereign relation before which all stand.

changed_reading.before: They simply enter and endure the blaze.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, exclusion from nearness leaves them bound in compulsory attendance to blaze, an inversion of maintained worship rather than an alternative translation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The snare branch is lexically remote from the local fire sense, but it is anchored in the same focus root and becomes mechanically coherent beside enrollment, marking, and confinement. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ص ل ي occurrence at word 3 has a set-trap branch, and the blaze noun at word 4 supplies the trap's terminal material condition.

changed_reading.after: As an affective overlay, the blaze writes a counter-radiance on formerly shameless, laughing faces and makes their condition publicly legible.

strongest_changes: The measuring, balance, debt, and return network turns fire-contact into the exact settlement of a one-sided exchange.
The record and earning sequences make the blaze both an executed inscription and the outward return of an inwardly accumulated condition.
The immediate veil and the opposed field of height, nearness, and water make the blaze an experienced form of relational exile.
The eye branch of ج ح م, activated by repeated looking and reversed spectatorship, preserves an exploratory reading of fire as exposure.
summary.what_was_special: The split ص ل ي mapping sustained literal heat across both targets while also opening coherent but contained worship, snare, and race-order resonances; ج ح م added eye, face, and shame activations that linked the focus to the surah's reversals of seeing and social display.
remaining_uncertainties: Fire-straightening may signify only forced exposure of distortion rather than any corrective process.
The ocular, ritual, snare, race, and facial models are branch-backed resonances, not secure replacements for the direct fire reading.
The accounting and earned-environment models may describe complementary causal levels, but the packet does not decide whether either is the primary mechanism.
